messages.subject: isolate() for plots+rasterImage
parts:
Hi guys,

I am building an app, where the user should be able to
- "draw" points on a picture.
- the picture is added with rasterImage()
- the rasterImage is original around 700kb and in R almost 50mb
--> I dont want to reload the plot everytime a point is "drawn" on the picture

Ideally I would like to have a static plot and dynamic points that are added.

Some naive attempts with isolate() did not work. They are not intended for plots ;)

Somebody an idea?

Kind regards
Andreas
